canonical_h36_encoder_block_erratum_and_.note_on_turn10_chat_prose: Turn-10 chat prose mistakenly wrote M4=TabPFN v2.5, M5=MiniRocket, M6=OpenML Meta22. The actual implemented and verified H36 encoder blocks are M0=LM_A0_H27_32D, M1=ANALYTIC_DOPE_V3_ROUTING_28D, M2=DOPE_HIGH_V3_629D_SVD32, M3=DOPE_NATIVE_280D_SVD32, M4=TABICL_V2_32D_SPREAD2 (bsd-3-clause), M5=KUMO_S_AND_L_64D_SPREAD4 (OpenMDW-1.1), and M6=MITRA_V2_32D_SPREAD2 (apache-2.0). Ridge Shapley OOF top-6 gain contributions for M4 (+0.018802), M5 (+0.000849), and M6 (+0.006567) are positive on strict_train_fit_881, whereas their dl_holdout_91 utility contributions are unfavorable (+0.001889, +0.000433, +0.001233) and neural arms N1..N7 tie on st_val_gate_32 (-1.736569).

three_stage2_survivor_gate_bugs_and_hypo.hypothesis_framing_disclosure: Attribution of the four H37 stage2_20 holdout30 regressions to specific mechanical survivor-gate bugs vs. heuristic fold-variance guards is treated as an explicit scientific hypothesis tested separately via the 6-gate ablation hierarchy (G0, G1A, G1B, G1C, G2, G3) in H38 replay and H39-H41 live reruns.

bug_1_key_mismatch_in_shrunken_nominatio.root_cause: compute_shrunken_inner_cv_nomination_score queried 'fold_logratios', 'std_fold_logratio', and 'max_fold_logratio', whereas rust_evaluator.py emits 'fold_log_ratios', 'cv_log_ratio_sd', and 'cv_tail_log_ratio'. Every lookup missed and defaulted to constant 0.20.

bug_2_unqualified_failed_cv_gate_challen.root_cause: Candidates with cv_gate_passed == False were appended to elites_by_arm_cid. When an incumbent had cv_gate_passed == False (fitness 101.431 on 03c4d094910c, 100.359 on 0cd637de21a9), degenerate challengers with fitness 100.000-100.014 sorted ahead of the incumbent.

bug_3_discontinuous_100_cliff_and_unpair.root_cause: Sorting on penalized fitness (+100.0 cliff when 1 of 7 folds has tail_lr > 0.02) allowed a challenger with 3x worse 7-fold mean (-0.27 vs -0.84 on 087f69944563) to overwrite the incumbent (isolated by G1C_SCHEMA_CV_GATE_AND_CONTINUOUS_7F_ONLY), and ignored paired fold differences delta_f = fold_log_ratios_cand[f] - fold_log_ratios_inc[f] (tested by G2 and G3).
